info.title: Financial APIs Supported Countries Reference
info.description: Retrieve the countries and states supported by the VAT, IBAN, and SWIFT APIs. The response always includes all three categories — VAT_Supported_Countries_And_States, IBAN_Supported_Countries, and SWIFT_Supported_Countries — each with a different shape. VAT entries are keyed by lowercase country name and include an ISO code plus, for a handful of countries (US, Canada, Spain), a nested map of sub-national state/region codes. IBAN and SWIFT entries are flat arrays of {name, countryCode} objects.

servers.description: Financial APIs Supported Countries API Server

get.description: Returns the countries and states supported by the VAT, IBAN, and SWIFT APIs.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Default is JSON.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Accepted by the endpoint but currently has no effect — all three categories (VAT, IBAN, SWIFT) are always returned regardless of this value.

200.description: Successful response — always returns all three categories

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

SupportedCountriesResponse.description: Countries and states supported by the VAT, IBAN, and SWIFT APIs.

VAT_Supported_Countries_And_States.description: Array of single-key objects, one per supported VAT country. Each key is the lowercase, underscore-separated country name.

items.description: A single VAT-supported country, keyed by its lowercase name.

IBAN_Supported_Countries.description: Array of countries supported by the IBAN Validation API.

SWIFT_Supported_Countries.description: Array of countries supported by the SWIFT/BIC Code Lookup and Finder APIs.

VatCountryEntry.description: VAT country metadata: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, plus an optional map of sub-national states/regions for countries with state-level VAT (US, Canada, Spain).

states.description: Map of state/region name to its combined country:state code. Only present for countries with sub-national VAT rates.

IbanCountryEntry.description: A single country supported by the IBAN Validation API.

SwiftCountryEntry.description: A single country supported by the SWIFT/BIC Code Lookup and Finder APIs.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
